title: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
title_zh: 从语言到内驱力：将自主机器人与人类目的对齐的多模态框架

paragraphs.en: 提出利用LLM和VLM将人类目的转化为机器人使命与内驱力的多模态对齐框架，实现人机目的对齐。 This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.
paragraphs.zh: 提出利用LLM和VLM将人类目的转化为机器人使命与内驱力的多模态对齐框架，实现人机目的对齐。本工作探索一种多模态方法，通过将大语言模型作为文化使能者，来使开放式学习自主机器人的行为与人类目的保持对齐。 虽然自主机器人能够通过与环境的交互生成自身的技能和目标，但它们往往缺乏确保这些技能和目标保持相关性并与人类用户目标保持一致的机制。 所提出的方法利用LLM和VLM中蕴含的通用知识和文化知识，建立一个多模态交互对齐过程，将用自然语言表达的人类目的转化为机器人架构中的动机组件，即以机器人使命和内驱力的形式来引导机器人的行为。 该系统被构建为三个层级，分别用于语义对齐、使命生成和内驱力建模。 这一设计实现了一个双向交互循环：人类输入定义高层目的，机器人利用LLM和VLM传递的多模态信息将其扩展为可执行的使命，而反馈机制则维持与人类意图的对齐。 在仿真和实体机器人上进行的实验表明，该过程能够生成有效的使命和行为，支持在自主机器人的交互场景中实现有效的人机智能体对齐。
